method: Each line is read in order: a line starting with # or ; is a comment, a line wrapped in [ ] opens a section, and any other line holding = is a pair whose key and value are trimmed and lowercased. Pairs before the first section form the preamble, where only root takes effect. Section names are globs: * matches any run of characters except /, ** matches any run including /, ? matches one character other than /, [seq] and [!seq] match one listed or one unlisted character, {a,b} matches any alternative with nesting allowed, and {1..4} matches the integers of an increasing range. The slashes written around ** stay literal, so a/**/b requires at least one directory between a and b. A brace without a comma, an unclosed bracket and a decreasing range are matched literally, a backslash escapes the next character, a - inside a class is a literal dash rather than a range, and a section name ending with / matches nothing. A name containing a / is anchored to the directory that holds this file, a name without one matches at that level and below, and a leading / changes nothing. Every matching section is applied in file order, so the last value for a property wins, unset clears a property, and an unsupported value for a recognised key is ignored so that an earlier value stands. tab_width defaults to indent_size, indent_size = tab takes the tab_width, and one indent level is built from as many whole tabs as fit with the remainder as spaces. Recognised keys are indent_style, indent_size, tab_width, end_of_line, charset, spelling_language, trim_trailing_whitespace and insert_final_newline; other keys are still reported. Limits are 400 lines and 64 KiB of configuration, 60 paths of at most 1,024 characters, and 1,024-character lines. Only the pasted file is read: parent .editorconfig files, the root search, editor integration and any file or network access are out of scope.
